Name: Farm Computer Regions
Author: ltlandhy
Description:
Any additional farms you own — Ginger Island, Greenhouse, mod-added areas — crops and machines on those tiles can be displayed.
[heading]Report Contents[/heading]
[list]
[*]Hay stored in silos[/*]
[*]Total crops / Crops ready to harvest / Unwatered crops[/*]
[*]Empty tilled soil[/*]
[*]Collectible items[/*]
[*]Machines with output ready to collect (including those placed inside buildings such as farmhouse, barns and sheds)[/*]
[*]Whether the Farm Cave has harvestable items[/*]
[/list][b]Greenhouse Section[/b]: The vanilla greenhouse gets its own separate entry — total crops / ready to harvest / unwatered, plus breakdown of machines inside.
[b]Building Section[/b]: Barns, coops, cabins, sheds… one line per building, listing animals and machines within it. Animals are detected whether they stay indoors or graze outside; no double-counting and no omissions.
[b]Outdoor Machines[/b]: Machine states split into three categories: Completed / In Progress / Idle.
[heading]Covered Locations[/heading]
By default, the mod reads all farm-like locations in your save: Main Farm, Ginger Island Farm, and mod-added tillable areas. Locations locked behind story quests or tasks will [b]only appear after you visit them once[/b]. It uses the game’s native "player has visited location" save flag to avoid spoiling unreleased areas. The Main Farm is exempt and always shown.
If you have [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) / Ridgeside Village (RSV) / East Scarp / Zuzu City[/b], the report marks each custom area with its mod source, example:
[code]Mod: Ridgeside Village (Rafseazz.RSVCP)[/code]. For locations not recognized by the built-in lookup table, you can manually define them in the config file.
[heading]Settings[/heading]
With [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] installed, tweak options in-game via
[code]Settings → Mod Settings[/code]:
Basic
[list]
[*]Enable location selection list[/*]
[*]Show "All Locations" option[/*]
[*]Hide empty locations[/*]
[*]Always show Main Farm[/*]
[*]Only show locations the player has visited[/*]
[*]Show yield summary in list[/*]
[*]Remember last selected location[/*]
[*]Play sound on panel open[/*]
[/list]Interface
[list]
[*]UI text scale (slider from 1.0–2.0; increase if text is too small)[/*]
[/list]The mod works without GMCM. Edit
[code]config.json[/code]inside the mod folder directly; both methods have identical effects.
Additional advanced options (force-include locations, exclude locations, custom display names, unlock conditions per location, list sorting) use list/dictionary structures and [b]can only be edited in config.json[/b]. Full tables and examples are provided in the README.
[b]To disable[/b]: Toggle off "Enable location selection list". The mod reverts fully to vanilla Farm Computer behaviour; right-click opens the original vanilla report.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b], requires [b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b]

[b]只要你还有其他农场 —— 姜岛、温室、模组新增区域 —— 这些地块上的作物与机器均可展示。[/b]
[heading][b]报告包含内容[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]筒仓干草存量[/b][/*]
[*][b]作物总数 / 可收获作物 / 未浇水作物[/b][/*]
[*][b]闲置耕地[/b][/*]
[*][b]可拾取采集物[/b][/*]
[*][b]可收取产出的加工机器（包含建筑内部，如农舍、鸡舍、小屋内放置的机器）[/b][/*]
[*][b]农舍洞穴是否有产物可收获[/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]温室小节[/b]：原版自带温室单独分项展示 —— 作物总数 / 可收获 / 未浇水，附带温室内部机器明细。
[b]建筑小节[/b]：畜棚、鸡舍、小屋、棚屋等，每个建筑单独一行，下方列出其内动物与机器。 动物无论在建筑内或是外出放牧均可识别，不会重复统计、也不会遗漏。
[b]露天放置机器[/b]：机器状态分为三类：已完成 / 运行中 / 空闲。[/b]
[heading][b]识别区域范围[/b][/heading]
[b]默认读取存档内所有可作为农场统计的地点：主农场、姜岛农场，以及模组新增可耕种地块。 需要推进剧情 / 任务解锁的区域，[b]玩家访问一次后才会在报告中出现[/b]，判定依据为游戏原生的「玩家是否到访过该位置」存档记录，避免提前剧透未解锁区域。 主农场不受该规则限制，始终显示。
若安装了[b]星露谷扩展（SVE）/ 里奇赛德村（RSV）/ 东崖 / 祖祖镇[/b]，报告会附加标注该地块所属模组，示例：[/b]
[code]模组：里奇赛德村 (Rafseazz.RSVCP)[/code][b]。 内置识别表无法自动识别的区域，可在配置文件手动添加。[/b]
[heading][b]设置项[/b][/heading]
[b]安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）[/b] 后，可在游戏内「设置 → 模组设置」调整参数：
基础选项[/b]
[list]
[*][b]启用区域选择列表[/b][/*]
[*][b]显示【全部区域】选项[/b][/*]
[*][b]隐藏空白区域[/b][/*]
[*][b]始终显示主农场[/b][/*]
[*][b]仅展示玩家已到访区域[/b][/*]
[*][b]列表显示产出汇总[/b][/*]
[*][b]记住上次选中的区域[/b][/*]
[*][b]打开面板时播放音效[/b][/*]
[/list][b]界面选项[/b]
[list]
[*][b]界面文字大小（滑块范围 1.0–2.0，文字偏小可以调大）[/b][/*]
[/list][b]未安装 GMCM 也可使用，直接修改 mod 目录内[/b]
[code]config.json[/code][b]文件，两种配置方式效果完全一致。
另有进阶细项（强制显示指定区域、排除指定区域、自定义显示名称、为区域设置解锁条件、列表排序），这类配置为列表与字典格式，[b]仅能在 config.json 内编写[/b]，README 文档附带完整参数表与示例。
[b]关闭本模组扩展功能[/b]：关闭「启用区域选择列表」，模组将完全回退至原版农场电脑，右键直接调出原版报告。[/b]
[heading][b]兼容性[/b][/heading]
[b]星露谷物语 1.6.15，依赖 SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上版本[/b]
